> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/automation.json`, `packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/automation.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **144** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 05f7758f054d70f3ba0f709b37423124be3e6e3d` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `7773245a2f0b1660afe4063a13db880385929b99` — the merge of head `a3b0809dd24087fabd8546299106ab1b4f8643b6` into base `05f7758f054d70f3ba0f709b37423124be3e6e3d`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 7773245a2f0b1660afe4063a13db880385929b99 && git checkout 7773245a2f0b1660afe4063a13db880385929b99
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 05f7758f054d70f3ba0f709b37423124be3e6e3d a3b0809dd24087fabd8546299106ab1b4f8643b6 && git checkout -B drift-repro 05f7758f054d70f3ba0f709b37423124be3e6e3d && git merge --no-ff a3b0809dd24087fabd8546299106ab1b4f8643b6

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 05f7758f054d70f3ba0f709b37423124be3e6e3d
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 05f7758f054d70f3ba0f709b37423124be3e6e3d` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a3b0809dd24087fabd8546299106ab1b4f8643b6`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/automation/flow-text-slot-template.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/action-copy-template.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/index.ts + packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.test.ts, packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts, packages/qa/dogfood/test/expression-conformance.ledger.ts, packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json, packages/spec/api-surface/automation.json, packages/spec/export-origins/ui.json, packages/spec/export-origins/automation.json, packages/spec/src/automation/flow-text-slot-template.test.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/action-copy-template.test.ts, .changeset/25680-action-copy-refusal.md, .changeset/25709-action-copy-holeless-dollar-refusal.md, content/docs/references/ui/action.mdx, content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx, content/docs/references/data/object.mdx, content/docs/references/kernel/metadata-plugin.mdx; read on main for the claims the hunks make: ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts (confirmMessage, composeSuccessMessage), packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts and packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts (the reported dogfood red), scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs (the DELIBERATE CORRECTION route). Narrowing face: every non-prose path of the diff is in scope; no remainder.

Inputs: card #25709 (body and all 7 comments, the os-dev-report 6411273906 included), PR #25989 (body, 21-file list, diff against its merge base 05f7758f), the 47 check-runs on the head. The one local checkout read is origin/main at cdd4eea93; main has since moved 3 commits past the PR base with no overlap on any touched path or on ActionRunner.ts (compare 05f7758f...main).

### Gate verdicts on the head

47 check-runs, all completed: 37 success, 9 skipped by workflow condition (Lint UI, Test UI, Temporal Conformance, Dogfood Verify CLI, the 3 dogfood shards, the two opt-in harnesses), 1 failure: Check Changeset. Its annotations name exactly one cause: `.changeset/25680-action-copy-refusal.md exists on the merge base and was not added by this PR` (the #17712 foreign-changeset refusal), with the two-class remedy text; the same run posts a notice recognising the new changeset's ADR-0087 exemption. That is the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class of scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs (route 0, remedy `do NOT restore it -- say so on the PR and get it confirmed`), declared on the PR body. Red by design, judged below in section ② sentence by sentence. Test Core (3/8) was in_progress at the first read and completed success before this record was rendered. Type Check · debt ledger and Lint & Repo Gates are green, which measures the two families the dev could not run locally (check:type-check-debt, check:dual-build-cjs-loads).

### ① Derived judgments

Premise (the card's precondition). RIGHT. On main, ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts `confirmMessage` returns the text unchanged when `hasTemplateHoles(text)` is false, and `composeSuccessMessage` returns `successCopy` as written on the same test; only a sentence with a `{{ }}` hole reaches `fillTemplateHoles`. The only `substituteScopeTokens` call left on copy is the `outcomeMessages` rung, which the card keeps out of the family. The `.objectui-sha` precondition of the card body is superseded by the premise correction 6409937588 (the `ui/` tree on main); the diff's rewording of `the pinned .objectui-sha` to `the ui/ tree` in the spec module note and the ledger rows is true.

Accept-set, the narrowing. RIGHT, and the only one. Before: at every door (`objectstack validate`, `compile`, the publish gate on an action, object or page write, and the draft promotion) a `confirmText` with no `{{ }}` hole whose every token is `${record.*}`, or a `successMessage` of that shape over `${result.*}`, drew `closedScopeTemplateRefusal`'s message plus the `TRANSITIONAL` suffix at severity warning, rode the advisory channel, and the row was stored (lint `isTransitionalDollar`, protocol pin (c) on main). After: the same sentence is `refuse(refusal, text)`, severity error, the write answers 422 INVALID_METADATA with one `expression-invalid` issue at the key, and nothing is stored. No other finding moves: every other branch of `judgeAction` was already `refuse(...)`, and `closedScopeTemplateRefusal` itself is untouched, so the prescription text (`Write X as Y` with the `{{ }}` hole) is unchanged and the `${{` guard still holds.

Error envelope. RIGHT. Every refusal in the family now goes through the one `refuse` closure (where, message, source, severity error), which is the envelope `validateStackExpressions` already carried for the other findings; the protocol pin (c) is rewritten in the exact shape of pin (a) on main (422, INVALID_METADATA, rule EXPRESSION_INVALID, one issue, `activePageRows(rows)` empty) and additionally pins the `{{ record.name }}` prescription in the message. The lint publish-gate pins assert one error on the error channel and an empty advisory channel for both a page write and an action write.

Stored data. RIGHT, covered by measured absence plus an unchanged parse. The parse is not touched: `actionCopyTemplateSlot` and its blank arm are outside the diff, and the spec test still pins `ok('Delete ${record.name}?')` parsing to the template envelope, so a stored row carrying the shape keeps loading until its next save (as #25680 shipped it). The producer count on the PR body (0 sentences of the shape across the four example stacks, platform-objects and plugin-approvals, with a planted control drawing the finding) is consistent with the #25680 note's own measurement, where this shape was a warning finding and all producers drew 0 findings. ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` is the #25702 precedent the card prescribes and the Check Changeset run recognises it.

Public surface. RIGHT. `@objectstack/spec/ui` loses `ACTION_COPY_DOLLAR_TRANSITION_ROOTS` and `@objectstack/spec/automation` loses `dollarOnlyTokenRoots`; both api-surface and export-origins snapshots drop exactly those two lines and nothing else, and both were the only lines #25702 added to those snapshots (git show 0c81694006). Never published: the `@objectstack/spec@18.1.0` tag is at e649c2d91 (2026-10-24 08:02Z), #25702 merged at 0c81694006 (2026-10-24 21:17Z), no tag contains 0c81694006, and the #25680 changeset is still pending on main. A repo-wide sweep on main for the two names, `isTransitionalDollar` and `A warning, not a refusal, for now` (ui/ included, node_modules and dist excluded) hits only files this diff rewrites; no reader is left. In `@objectstack/lint` the deleted `TRANSITIONAL` and `isTransitionalDollar` were module-private, so lint's public surface does not move. `@objectstack/dogfood` is private; `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` moves only in a test.

Describes and reference pages. RIGHT. The `transition(root)` sentence is deleted from the two describes and the four generated pages lose exactly that sentence (eight table rows); no hand-written page under content/docs states the warning (sweep for `still fill`, `transitional`, `warning, not a refusal`, and `${record.` / `${result.` in copy context, releases excluded: no hit). The Docs Drift Check comment lists pages by the field names `confirmText` / `successMessage` only; none of them restates the retired rule.

Ledger rows. RIGHT. Both `enforcement` strings now say a holeless sentence is shown as written, read in the `ui/` tree; true against ActionRunner on main.

One wording left behind, non-blocking. packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.test.ts keeps two unchanged context comments inside the renamed `refuses a ${…} token in every other shape too` case: line 72 `composeSuccessMessage substitutes ${result.*} alone` and line 76 `The ${…} evaluator does not bind the static params`. Both describe the runner reading objectui#13476 retired; the assertions under them are right (every shape is an error). Not in the dev's sweep terms, so not a sweep miss by its own definition; a one-line follow-up, not a verdict.

### ② Semver level

Changeset `.changeset/25709-action-copy-holeless-dollar-refusal.md`: `@objectstack/lint` minor, `@objectstack/spec` minor, title with `!`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing: ...)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, exactly one ADR-0087 marker, a FROM/TO block and a one-line fix. The PR body carries the same `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`. RIGHT for what the diff publishes: a value refused that saved with a warning is `narrowed`, which takes at least minor on both moved packages (AGENTS.md rule 3), and the retired exports never reached a published version, so there is no removal to carry a migration for; the changeset states that fact in the body. `skip-changeset` is correctly not applied. The spec's `packages/spec/package.json` is 18.1.0 and the pending #25680 note is in the same release, so the two entries ship together, which is what the next paragraph relies on.

The rewrite of the pending `.changeset/25680-action-copy-refusal.md` (DELIBERATE CORRECTION, Check Changeset red by design), each sentence before and after:

1. Summary sentence. Before: `They are now errors, all but one.` TRUE on main (the holeless shape is a warning on main), FALSE after this diff. After: `They are now errors.` TRUE after this diff (every `closedScopeTemplateRefusal` finding is `refuse(...)`), and it is the sentence the release will ship, since both notes release together.
2. The `Still a warning.` paragraph. Before: TRUE on main (`isTransitionalDollar`, `ACTION_COPY_DOLLAR_TRANSITION_ROOTS`, the `for now` suffix all exist there), FALSE after this diff on every clause, and it names a `.objectui-sha` that no longer exists. After: `The holeless ${…} sentence too. ${record.*} in a confirmText and ${result.*} in a successMessage, in a sentence with no {{ }} hole and no other token, is refused as well: the console's runner shows it as written. Its own entry in this release says so (#25709).` TRUE after this diff (the lint branch, the protocol pin, ActionRunner on main, and the new changeset in the same release).
3. The exports bullet. Before: `No schema shape moves. @objectstack/spec adds two exports: ACTION_COPY_DOLLAR_TRANSITION_ROOTS (...) and dollarOnlyTokenRoots (...).` TRUE on main, FALSE after this diff. After: `No schema shape moves, and @objectstack/spec adds no export.` TRUE after this diff, judged against the released 18.1.0 snapshot: #25702 added exactly those two lines to the api-surface and this diff removes exactly them, so the release's net export delta from the two notes is zero.

The rewrite touches nothing else in the note (frontmatter, declaration lines, the ADR-0087 marker and the measurement bullet are unchanged). Leaving the note as it stands on main would ship three false sentences in the same CHANGELOG entry, which is the class the gate's own remedy says not to restore. This record is the written judgment the gate's remedy asks for on the PR: each rewritten sentence is true against the diff and main.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev deviations (os-dev-report 6411273906) and the one out-of-scope finding; `open_questions` is empty.

1. `.changeset/25680` edited beyond `one changeset`. ANSWERED: judged true sentence by sentence in ② ; the red Check Changeset is the designed route 0 and is the only red on the head.
2. Test files and four generated reference pages edited outside the claimed file surface. ANSWERED, not a breach: the claim comment 6410153130 names `the test files of these modules` and `4 generated reference pages under content/docs` in its file surface, and the pages regenerate from the describes through check:generated (Lint & Repo Gates green).
3. Dogfood battery launched at 5a6ed48a, one commit before the head. ANSWERED: compare 5a6ed48a...a3b0809d is one commit, one file, one line (the tracker id taken out of the ledger's prose string in expression-conformance.ledger.ts, which check:doc-authoring had refused); the ledger's own test was re-run on the head (8/8) and Lint & Repo Gates on the head carries check:doc-authoring. CI's dogfood shards are skipped on `pull_request` by the workflow condition (ci.yml line 2198), so the local run is the battery the `(narrowing)` arm owes, and it is full: 299 files, one red.
4. HotCRM not re-measured, though the card body names it. ESCALATED to the seat, with the standing reading: the #25680 note measured HotCRM at a4b3560 through the built lint whose warning branch fired for exactly this shape, and all 20 copy sentences drew 0 findings, so HotCRM carried 0 of the shape at a4b3560; anything HotCRM wrote after a4b3560 is unmeasured, and the repository is not reachable from this review session (objectstack-ai/hotcrm is not enabled here and code search is blocked), so this record cannot close it. A sentence of the shape there would fail HotCRM's own build, not a stored row, so the exposure is a downstream build red, not data. The seat re-measures at HotCRM's current sha or accepts the a4b3560 reading in writing.
5. Out-of-scope finding, class a: dogfood red `test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts`, control `handleI18nRequest` expected 3, read 4 on packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts. CONFIRMED main's, not this diff's: i18n.ts at the PR base 05f7758f carries 4 occurrences against the census pin of 3 (authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts line 1084), last moved by #25956 (69fa23d60) on main; this diff touches neither file. Reported by the dev with dedupe words; a card is owed by the seat for the census count, outside this PR.

The dev's two NOT-MEASURED local families are measured green on the head by Type Check · debt ledger and Lint & Repo Gates. The ablation on the PR body (refusal branch mutated back to a warning: 6 lint pins and protocol pin (c) red, restore verified) is the dev's own evidence and is consistent with the pins this record read; it was not re-run here.

## 席位核对

ACCEPT · domain:spec seat 2 · 2026-10-26T08:41Z · head `a3b0809dd24087fabd8546299106ab1b4f8643b6`

1. **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, `!` title, closes #25709. 21 files, +115/−178. `check-governed-merges --pr 25989`: NOT governed.
2. **Premise and stop conditions.** The premise held: the console returns holeless copy as written (`ActionRunner` confirmMessage / composeSuccessMessage). The card's ordered producer measurement over `examples/**` found 0, and so did platform-objects and plugin-approvals. The landing point is as ordered. The claim's file surface was amended for the tests, the 4 generated pages and the #25680 changeset correction.
3. **Gates (check-runs pinned to this head).** 47 runs: 37 success, 9 skipped, 1 failure. `check-expected-skips --pr 25989`: OK.
   - The failure is `Check Changeset`, red by design on the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class (route 0: this PR corrects the pending `.changeset/25680-action-copy-refusal.md`). The three conditions for landing past it hold:
     - `.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml` names this red as by design;
     - that workflow runs on `pull_request` only, never `merge_group`;
     - this comment records the gate and its cause.
4. **Contract review.** PASS at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` on this head, comment 6411796404 (narrowing face, scope every non-prose path). The record judges each rewritten #25680 sentence: each was true on main, is false after the diff, and is replaced by a true one. That is the confirmation the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class requires.
5. **Narrowing.** `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` on the PR body and the changeset. The dogfood battery ran at `5a6ed48a`: 2522 of 2523. The head differs from it by one ledger string, and the battery was re-run 8/8 on it. The one red is main's `authz-probe-blind-spot` census on `packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts` after #25956, which this diff does not touch. That red is anchored on card #25988.
   - The two withdrawn exports were never published: the `@objectstack/spec@18.1.0` tag predates #25702's merge, which added them.
6. **Accepted, not fixed here.**
   - HotCRM was not re-measured from this session; its standing reading at #25680 is 0 of the refused shape. A HotCRM producer would show up as a downstream build red, not as lost data.
   - Two unchanged test comments, at `packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.test.ts:72` and `:76`, still describe the retired runner reading. The assertions beneath them are right. Tests are not published, so this is a nit.
7. **Landing.** Ready plus auto-merge, past the by-design `Check Changeset` red.
